required_changes_injected: FAIL: Criterion 2 (Carry-forward consistency) — Decision Criteria score dropped from 8/10 to 6/10 without documented reason. Analysis notes 'broader and less formally prioritized' but this is analyst interpretation, not prospect contradiction. February criteria (Snowflake, Firebase, migration smoothness) remain valid and uncontradicted. April additions (Notion/Slack, MCP, API) extend but do not replace them. Score should maintain 8/10 with note: 'February criteria remain valid; April call added extensibility interests without contradicting core requirements.' FAIL: Criterion 2 — Decision Process score dropped from 8/10 to 4/10. Analysis correctly identifies POC status unknown, but this is a process status gap, not a regression in decision process structure. February established April target and four-workstream POC scope — both remain valid. Score should be 6/10 (process defined but status unclear) with explicit note: 'POC structure from February remains valid; April status unknown requires immediate clarification.' FAIL: Criterion 2 — Champion score dropped from 8/10 to 2/10. Analysis states 'no internal selling actions documented' but this is absence of evidence, not evidence of absence on a single follow-up call. February established Anna initiated evaluation and owns decision (champion-level authority). April call did not contradict this; it simply did not mention internal selling. Carry-forward rule requires: 'No new champion information in April call — maintaining previous score of 8/10 with note that internal advocacy remains unvalidated.' Score should be 7/10 (authority confirmed, advocacy unvalidated) not 2/10. FAIL: Criterion 4 — Next step for Decision Process uses vague verb 'where do things stand' without specific action. Rewrite: 'Ask Anna Barnett on next call: Has the POC concluded? If yes, share results. If in progress, what is revised completion date? If stalled, what blockers exist?' FAIL: Criterion 3 — Metrics evidence quality. Score 4/10 lacks direct quote for business outcome. 'Conversion rate identified' is named but not quantified as prospect-originated metric. Evidence is thin; score should reflect this but next step is strong. PASS: Criterion 1 — all components have status, score, evidence. PASS: Criterion 3 — EPPO competitor correctly mapped (not in GrowthBook list but acceptable as incumbent). PASS: Criterion 4 — next steps specific and actionable with contact names and concrete questions. PASS: Criterion 5 — no unsupported claims; uncertainty acknowledged throughout.
